programs.title: Mountain Life 3
programs.desc: Julia and Samit live with their daughter in North Bend.They decided to find a house with more space and better views.However, they do not want to move out of the town so that they can still enjoy the charms of the Cascade Mountains that surround the area.They also want their daughter to stay close to her friends.She dreams of a house with an open floor plan, large windows that will let in plenty of natural light and space to set up a home theater.The market in the North Bend area is very competitive, but their broker knows they will find a real gem for them.
